headline: Jaynes--Cummings dynamics decomposes exactly into conserved-excitation blocks with closed dressed spectrum and propagator
nonclaims: priority for the Jaynes--Cummings model, dressed states or Rabi oscillations
the finite excitation grid proves an infinite-dimensional operator theorem
dressed energies or Rabi frequencies are target zeros or arithmetic spectral data
an ordinary trace or Fredholm determinant exists for the full Fock-space unitary
a Hilbert-Polya operator, target divisor, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, external peer review, or Route-B authorization

boundary_rows.statement: n=0 is one-dimensional and is not inserted into the n>=1 square-root formula
g=0 gives diagonal bare evolution, including the Omega=0 continuous-limit block
Delta=0 gives complete exchange amplitude for every coupled block
g and -g are related by a diagonal atomic phase and have identical energies and probabilities
a finite Fock compression preserves excitation blocks below its top dangling state
the full unitary has infinite singular values equal to one and is neither compact nor Schatten
finite-support population and full state-vector revival conditions are distinguished

route_a.strongest_failure: Natural quantization of the source model supplies no rational-prime carrier, primitive-orbit clock, target divisor or target analytic structure and is not a Hilbert-Polya bridge.
route_a.strongest_positive: The system is already a natural self-adjoint quantum Hamiltonian with an exact conserved-excitation spectral and unitary decomposition.

theorem.boundaries: g=0 decouples the bare states; Delta=0 gives Omega_n=2*|g|*sqrt(n); n=0 is the separate vacuum; g and -g are unitarily gauge-equivalent; finite Fock cutoffs retain the blocks below the top boundary
theorem.conservation: [H,N]=0, so the vacuum and every fixed-excitation subspace are invariant
theorem.invariants: Each block propagator is unitary, tr(U_n)=2*exp(-i*c_n*t)*cos(Omega_n*t/2), det(U_n)=exp(-2i*c_n*t), c_n=(n-1/2)*omega_c
theorem.operator_boundary: On the full Fock space the unitary is noncompact and not Schatten, so no ordinary trace or Fredholm determinant is asserted
theorem.population_revival: For a finite active set of coupled bare blocks, universal bare-population revival at T>0 holds iff Omega_n*T is in 2*pi*Z for every active n; equivalently their positive Omega_n are rationally commensurate
theorem.state_revival: A common state-vector revival additionally requires alignment of the block center phases, the parity signs from Omega_n*T/(2*pi), and any occupied vacuum phase
theorem.transition: P_{|e,n-1> to |g,n>}(t)=(4*g^2*n/Omega_n^2)*sin^2(Omega_n*t/2), interpreted as zero when g=Delta=0
